instruction: A candid documentary photograph with a full shot from a side angle captures an indoor motion capture studio with a dark red carpeted floor and white walls. The man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands on the left in profile, extending his right arm to grasp the upper arm of the woman in the white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2). The woman (R2) stands on the right, facing left in profile towards the man with a neutral expression. The scene is illuminated by even overhead indoor lighting, casting soft shadows on the red carpet.

R2 is the person whose upper arm is being grasped by R1
